projectName: PI05 — Pi0.5 VLA Robot Learning Suite
projectDescription: Standalone repository for PI0.5 Vision-Language-Action (VLA) dataset preparation, LoRA fine-tuning, export, and deployment for bimanual robotic manipulation using PyTorch, LeRobot, ROS 2 Jazzy, PEFT, and Accelerate.

layers.name: Infrastructure & Build
layers.description: Non-Python project scaffolding: YAML configuration files, shell scripts, ROS 2 launch files, documentation, and CI/packaging assets. These files are consumed by tools and entry points but do not define runtime behavior themselves.

layers.name: Common: Config Schema
layers.description: Typed YAML config schema shared by training and deployment. Defines ExperimentConfig, LoraConfig, DataConfig, TrainingConfig, and related dataclasses with from_mapping() factories. The only dependency is pi05.common.utils.paths for PROJECT_ROOT resolution.

layers.name: Common: Utilities
layers.description: Project path resolution and sys.path bootstrapping. Provides PROJECT_ROOT, COMMON_SRC_ROOT, TRAIN_SRC_ROOT, DEPLOY_SRC_ROOT constants and bootstrap_project_paths() for non-installed entry points. Has zero internal project dependencies.

layers.name: Common: Robot Specification
layers.description: Robot action layout contracts shared by training and deployment. Defines ARM_DOF, ACTION_DIM (14), STATE_DIM (26), ARM_JOINT_NAMES, BimanualAction dataclass with split/assemble helpers, and JointLimitSpec for per-joint safety clamping. Depends only on NumPy.

layers.name: Common: ROS Topic Definitions
layers.description: Frozen dataclasses (Pi05CommandTopics, Pi05ObservationTopics) defining the canonical ROS 2 topic paths under the /pi05_vla namespace. Zero project dependencies — pure string constants and a topic joining helper.

layers.name: Common: Data Codecs & Normalization
layers.description: Shared data pipeline components: action encoding/decoding (ensure_action_vector, split_action), state encoding (BimanualState, encode_bimanual_state, 26-D vector contract), min-max normalization to [-1,1] with Q99.5 statistics via LeRobotDataset, and deterministic image preprocessing (resize_crop/resize_pad to CHW float tensors). Core dependency for both training data loading and deployment observation assembly.

layers.name: Common: Model Builder
layers.description: Pi0.5 policy construction with LoRA adapter wrapping. build_pi05_with_lora loads a pretrained PI0.5 checkpoint (default: lerobot/pi05_base), configures LoRA via PEFT (rank, alpha, dropout, target_modules), and returns the wrapped nn.Module. Uses PI05Config, PI05Policy from vendored LeRobot reference. Depends on ExperimentConfig for model/pretrained/lora hyperparameters.

layers.name: Common: Bundle I/O
layers.description: Deploy bundle export and loading. export_deploy_bundle packages LoRA adapter weights, experiment config, normalizer statistics, and tactile preprocess metadata into a portable directory structure. Load side resolves the bundle at deployment time. Bridges the training output format to the deployment input format.

layers.name: Deploy: Config Schema
layers.description: Deployment-specific YAML config schema. Defines DeployConfig, BundleConfig, RuntimeConfig (inference_hz, control_hz, chunk_size, device, dtype, safety limits), SafetyConfig, CameraConfig, BridgeConfig, MuxConfig, and ROS topic bindings. Separate from ExperimentConfig — deployment only needs runtime/ROS settings plus bundle path.

layers.name: Deploy: Policy Loader
layers.description: Bundle-only Pi0.5 policy runtime for deployment. Pi05PolicyRuntime loads a prebuilt model + LoRA adapters from safetensors, attaches pre/post processors from LeRobot, initializes normalizers, and optionally compiles the model with torch.compile. Bridges common.model.builder (training-side construction) into a deployable runtime object.

layers.name: Deploy: Runtime Infrastructure
layers.description: Core real-time runtime components for VLA inference deployment. Includes: SharedBuffer (thread-safe LatestQueue-based handoff of InferenceRequest/ActionChunk/ObservationSnapshot between collector and inference threads), InferenceWorker (async background thread polling policy), ControlLoop (high-rate action consumer with smoothstep blending, fallback, and time alignment), ObservationCollector (multi-callback ROS message assembly into BimanualState), and SafetyGuard (joint limit clamping, delta rate limiting, stale observation detection). This is the central runtime fabric.

layers.name: Deploy: ROS 2 Nodes
layers.description: ROS 2 Jazzy nodes implementing the deployment pipeline. Pi05VlaDeployNode: main orchestrator — subscribes to camera/proprioception topics, runs the inference pipeline, publishes command topics. Pi05BridgeNode: adapts /pi05_vla/command topics to downstream VLA candidate topics with deadman signal generation. CommandMuxNode: teleop/VLA command arbitration multiplexer that gates which source drives the physical robot. All nodes use MultiThreadedExecutor.

layers.name: Deploy: ROS Compatibility Wrapper
layers.description: Thin backward-compatibility wrapper in pi05.deploy.ros that re-exports main() from pi05.deploy.ros_nodes.pi05_vla_deploy_node. Exists to support legacy imports or alternate entry point discovery without changing the canonical node location.

layers.name: Deploy: CLI Entry Points
layers.description: Thin console_scripts entry points that bootstrap project paths and launch ROS 2 nodes. deploy_ros.py -> Pi05VlaDeployNode, bridge_ros.py -> Pi05BridgeNode, command_mux_ros.py -> CommandMuxNode. Each calls bootstrap_project_paths() first, then defers to the corresponding ros_node main().

layers.name: Train: Dataset
layers.description: LeRobot-backed PyTorch Dataset for Pi0.5 offline training. Pi05LeRobotDataset wraps LeRobotDataset with action chunking (default 30-step windows), optional online ColorJitter augmentation, identity-normalized image pipeline (avoids double normalization with PI0.5 internal [-1,1] mapping), and per-sample tensor assembly.

layers.name: Train: Engine
layers.description: Core training engine for LoRA fine-tuning. Components: trainer.py (main training loop with gradient accumulation, logging, checkpointing, bundle export after training), builders.py (optimizer AdamW + cosine scheduler + dataloader construction with normalizer bootstrap), batches.py (key remapping from local dataset format to LeRobot PI0.5 preprocessor schema), checkpoints.py (epoch adapter save/load, final adapter extraction, Accelerate state resume). The trainer depends on common.runtime.bundle for post-training export.

layers.name: Train: Utilities
layers.description: Training support utilities: logging configuration (Accelerate-compatible basicConfig), seed reproducibility (wrapper around accelerate.utils.set_seed), TensorBoard process lifecycle management (automatic launch, port conflict detection, reuse detection via ps inspection). Used by the training CLI and engine.

layers.name: Train: CLI Entry Points
layers.description: Thin console_scripts entry points for training workflows. train.py: loads ExperimentConfig, bootstraps paths, defers to trainer.train_from_config(). export_bundle.py: loads config, resolves adapter/output directories, calls common.runtime.bundle.export_deploy_bundle() to create deployable artifacts from a finished training run.

layers.name: Tests
layers.description: Unit and integration tests for the PI05 project. Currently includes deploy config validation tests and training config schema tests.

notes.architecturalPattern: Layered with two top-level consumers (train and deploy) sharing a common core library. The common layer grows upward from primitive utilities through robot specs, data codecs, model construction, to bundle I/O. Deploy and Train each add their own config, runtime/engine, CLI, and ROS/test layers on top. The bundle (common.runtime.bundle) is the formal bridge: exported by train after training and consumed by deploy at startup.
keyInsights: The common layer is NOT flat — it has its own internal layering: utils -> robot -> data -> config -> model -> bundle, with clear upward dataflow.
Deploy runtime is the most complex layer — it implements a multi-threaded real-time pipeline (collector -> shared buffer -> inference worker -> control loop) with explicit safety gating.
The bundle I/O module (common.runtime.bundle) is the only cross-cutting bridge between train and deploy — the formal artifact handoff point.
Training and deployment configs are intentionally separate schemas (ExperimentConfig vs DeployConfig) to decouple training-specific hyperparameters from runtime/ROS settings.
There are exactly 3 ROS nodes launched as separate processes: Pi05VlaDeployNode (policy inference), Pi05BridgeNode (command adaptation), CommandMuxNode (teleop/VLA arbitration).
The safety layer (SafetyGuard + SafetyConfig + JointLimitSpec) is embedded in the deploy runtime and applies before any command publication — it is NOT in the common layer.
Zero circular dependencies detected between packages — all imports flow unidirectionally from train/deploy downward into common.
notes.layerDependencyRule: Files in a layer may import from any layer with a lower rank value. No layer should import from a layer with a higher rank value (no upward dependencies). Cross-package imports between Train and Deploy at the same rank are forbidden — the bundle artifact is the only intended bridge.
